QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] A Shabby Bouquet
QuestInfo.0:
You haven't gotten the flowers wrapped yet.
Go to #bSion#k and ask for the flowers to be wrapped.
QuestInfo.1: Hunt #bTree Rod#k in #bMossy Tree Forest#k and get #bTree Rod Tree Branch#k.
QuestInfo.2: Sion used the Tree Branch to tie the flowers into a bouquet. It looks shabby, but that's the best that can be done in this place.

default.0: The #bTree Rod#k is in #bMossy Tree Forest#k.
